race.comment: LATIN LIGHTS (4) looks up to this stronger contest after scoring a dominant Maiden win over 1700m at Grafton. Drops slightly in trip and can stalk the speed. Hard to hold out. ARTIE LADY (9) is another from the Matt Dunn yard with her hoof on the till. Strong through the line when she jumped in trip for a sound fourth over 1612m at Coffs Harbour. At her top now and gets every chance from the low gate. DARK CHILL (1) tough old gelding due for a change of luck. Held his ground through the line with a close up fourth over 1410m at Lismore. This trip suits with the key jockey change. GAMING (2) improved sharply deep into the trip when he sat on the speed to salute over 1310m at Lismore. On the quick backup and worth thought. NARUKAMI (3) has won two of his last three starts and stays in the mix.
